description: Writes an alignment (gapped rows) in an EMBOSS 6.6.0 -aformat output format, byte for byte as the installed programs print it: PAIRWISE formats (two rows; header with program, run date, command line, matrix, gap penalties and Length / Identity / Similarity / Gaps / Score): pair, simple, srspair, srs, markx0, markx1, markx2, markx3, markx10, match, score, sam, tcoffee, unknown, multiple; SEQUENCE-SET formats (any number of rows): fasta, a2m, msf, clustal, mega, meganon, nexus, paup, nexusnon, paupnon, phylip, phylipnon, selex, treecon. VERIFICATION: 3 303 needle / water / stretcher files (29 formats x 114 alignment sets, faked run dates) and 1 309 seqret files (11 sequence-set formats, 1-9 rows) identical to the installed EMBOSS 6.6.0.

alignedSequences.description: Aligned rows ('-' = gap): two for the pairwise formats, one or more for the sequence-set formats.

offsets.description: Residues of each original sequence before the aligned part.

offends.description: Residues of each original sequence after the aligned part.

matrix.description: Matrix deciding the similarity marks (EMBOSS / NCBI name); default by sequence type.

commandLine.description: Command-line arguments printed in the header.

dialect.description: 'emboss' (default): the EMBOSS 6.6 writers named above. 'biopython': the Biopython 1.88 Bio.Align writers fasta, a2m, clustal, phylip, nexus, stockholm (byte for byte as Bio.Align.write; the descriptions are written, the Clustal header says Biopython 1.88).

errors.message: alignedSequences is null or empty, a pairwise format without exactly two rows
unknown format, matrix or malformed runDate
